title: BOSCH ‎ All-in-One Hand Tool Kit, 108 Pieces, Rachet...
description: Comprehensive Tool Selection: The BOSCH 108 pcs Multi-Function Household Set is curated toolkit featuring essential hand tools and bits, all neatly organized in a compact suitcase for easy portability, making it perfect for tasks ranging from basic repairs to professional projects. BOSCH hand tools are crafted from premium materials and designed with ergonomic handles for comfortable, long-lasting use. Rachet Screwdriver & Allen Key: This boasts fixed clockwise and counterclockwise motion for effortless use, providing various functions with a positive and reverse rotation design. It's simple to operate, featuring an eco-friendly thermoplastic rubber grip for enhanced comfort and longevity. Durable allen key set for precision and versatility, perfect for tightening or loosening hexagonal bolts with ease and reliability. Multiple Drill Bits: The BOSCH toolkit features 8 precision bits designed for careful tasks such as putting together or taking apart eyeglasses, toys, watches, and smartphones. Screwdriver bits intended for assembling furniture, electrical equipment, and toys. Sockets useful for repairing bicycles, electric fans, or hex screws. Masonry drill bits, dowel plugs, and screws for a range of household and professional uses. Hammer, Combination Plier & Wrench: The German-style pliers are equipped with a thermoplastic rubber handle that provides a secure and comfortable hold, a horn-shaped edge that facilitates easy nail extraction, and a reinforced head for enhanced durability. Its ergonomic structure guarantees simplicity in use, adaptability, and smooth performance. The wrench is equipped with a precise worm mechanism for seamless adjustments, this 15 cm saw boasts a compact form and an ergonomic design that provides a comfortable hold. Versatile Cutting Saw, Cutter & measuring Tape: Its sharp, resilient, and long-lasting sawblade featuring outward-facing teeth guarantees effortless and effective cutting, making it perfect for thin wood tasks. The cutter offers an automatic stop lock for added safety, making both tools safer and more convenient to use. The measuring tape features a thin, CE-certified design with three lock/stop modes for easy use.
